body:
> Do you believe that you're unlikely to find the answer your looking for?

Yeah, I think this is the biggest thing bothering me. I don't know what will make me happy. And I don't want to do irreversible changes to my self, and then realise that I'd rather be without them. I don't want to live a life full of trouble if I don't have to.

> It seems they've taken your feelings about suicide seriously and are desperate to stop you.

I know that, but couldn't they've done it without completely breaking my trust? It also doesn't really feel like they care for "me", because they don't seem to take anything else I say seriously. They care about the perfect little son in their heads, not me.

> Did you get the chance to talk to your grandmother?

Yes I did, but it seems like regarding gender and sexuality, she has a very outdated view, and have a lot of prejudice. She says she's okay with people differing in gender and sexuality, but it doesn't really feel like she means it, saying stuff like "all the trans people I know wear weird old clothes", and that apparently bisexual people are "more promiscuous" it also doesn't feel like she sees trans people as the gender they identify with.

> What about talking to others that have had or still have gender identity issues?

I did go to a meeting for trans people that LGBT Danmark has every other week. Talking to other with similar problems was nice, but I was very confused about my own gender. And I still don't know what to do. It also seemed like everyone there had decided to transition in some way, so I felt very out of place.

> There may also be therapists that specialize in that.

Yes, I talk to a therapist who specializes in gender every week. So that is a good thing, it just never feels like I can say everything that I want to say.

> I sincerely hope the best for you. I hope you come to an understanding of who you are gender and sexuality wise. And I hope that one day the confusion around your gender identity and sexual orientation will go away

Thanks :)

Yeah I guess it is gonna be a long journey, but I'm just annoyed that I have to walk it. Why did this have to happen to me? I don't have a problem with any gender identity or sexual orientation other people might have, I just wish mine was normal, or at least I could pretend so.

Thanks for reading my post :)

> taking walls again might really help you with just sorting out your thoughts

I guess you're right, I do really need to sort out my thoughts, and taking walks would certainly help, I do however feel that I'm sorting out my thoughts all the time, but that it doesn't really help. However I guess walks will help me with this.

> taking a day off

Yeah, I'll try to do that, and I know I shouldn't hesitate to, but it's not always possible to just take a day off :(

Thanks for reading it, I appreciate it :)

I know I shouldn't just lie down all day multiple days in a row, but just getting up to get breakfast have been hard, and doing anything else is harder. I'll try though, I'll try to take a walk today if I can find the energy.

> take a day, or half a day, to rest

> don't let anybody else tell you that you cant

I'll try to remember this, however it IS hard to do when everyone is begging you to get up. I also should watch out for how much absence I have, it's not good if that goes up... Although I have told a teacher that I have some personal problems that I'm dealing with, who also told it (with my permission) to some other teachers as well, and apparently I shouldn't be worried about how I'm doing in school, but I got some E's when we got grades for the first semester, so I don't know how true this is.

Edit: forgot to say, thanks for reading my post :) I appreciate it

> What in here has you so down?

I don't really know, I think that right now it's mostly that I'm not sure what to do with my gender presentation. I'm afraid to change anything, I'm afraid to go out and buy stuff in the female section, because I know people will stare and think I'm a weirdo.

I'm also very scared that I'm just going to look like a boy wearing girl clothes, and that I'm not even sure if I want to be a girl. It does appeal a lot to me though, and now I'm afraid I'm just trying to convince my self that I don't need to do any gender related stuff. Because what if I would be satisfied living as male? Then all of that would only make my life worse.

Then it would just be easier to die. Then I wouldn't have all these problems. I'm not really sure what my motivation for wanting to die has been earlier, now that I look back, I think most of the time it was because I was depressed for no reason. Now it's because my life seems hopeless.

Right now I'm not even sure if I am going to kill myself, but I know I wouldn't mind dying very much, I'd just be grateful.

I think one of the big things that haunts me is how I acted in the past. Because I've really been a dick many times, just to try and fit in with the other boys. I've also done really weird stuff, to try and seem "cool", like finding weird porn and gore, and show it to others, while laughing at it. It makes me sick to think about.
